label: Asymptotic-closure census control
title: The asymptotic-closure gate is broad, not discriminative
summary: An independent census reproduces the 54/110 values but finds 41 of 88 canonical ECA representatives pass the full corridor-plus-growth gate, including 37 non-IV rules. Rule 62 nearly shadows Rule 110 on the primary coordinates.
takeaway: The corridor is a broad necessary-condition-like geometry, not a Class-IV discriminator; matched controls are needed to study what the retained history actually does.
